lines.en: label toukadorm1:
scene dorm2
I knock on Touka’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲开 Touka 的门，等她应声。

lines.en: I’ve already made it known that I routinely drop by everyone’s rooms and, tonight, the lucky recipient of my highly demanded company is her.
lines.zh: 我早就放过话，说我平常会挨个儿串每个人的房间，而今晚，我这「抢手陪伴」的幸运得主就是她。

lines.en: Which is not to say I imagine she wants it or anything.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我以为她想要我陪之类的。

lines.en: In fact, I’m sure a good portion of this visit will just involve her complaining about her roommate.
lines.zh: 其实我很确定，这次造访有一大半就是听她抱怨她室友。

lines.en: But her complaints can only last so long. And I am determined to make this room yet another home away from home for me.
lines.zh: 可抱怨总有尽头。而且我打定主意，要把这间房也变成我另一个「家外之家」。

lines.en: : H...Hello?
lines.zh: : 你……你好？

lines.en: : Who goes there?
lines.zh: : 谁在那儿？

lines.en: : I go here. It’s me.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿。是我。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : If I let you inside, may I proceed to angrily vent at you in a rather unladylike manner?
lines.zh: : 要是我放你进来，我能接着用一种很不淑女的方式冲你发火吗？

lines.en: : That directly depends on how much clothing you are wearing.
lines.zh: : 这直接取决于你穿了多少衣服。

lines.en: : I am wearing all of my clothes. And I greatly appreciate you asking to be sure you don’t walk in on me looking anything less than appropriate.
lines.zh: : 我把衣服都穿着。也很感激你特意确认，免得撞见我衣着不得体。

lines.en: : Yes. That is exactly why I was asking. I am a good guy.
lines.zh: : 对。我问正是为这个。我是个好人。

lines.en: : You...have your moments.
lines.zh: : 你……偶尔算是吧。

lines.en: : You may enter, Sensei. But please do not make a mess of the place. The maid just left for the night.
lines.zh: : 你可以进来，Sensei。但请别把这儿弄乱。女佣刚下班走了。

lines.en: scene black
: ...Maid?
Touka unlocks the door before letting me in and I can’t help but think of how far the two of us have come in just the short time we’ve known each other.
lines.zh: Touka 开了锁让我进去，我忍不住想：我俩认识才没多久，居然已经走到这一步了。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm1
: This is nice.
lines.zh: : 这儿不错。

lines.en: : I feel like it was just the other day you were trying to get me fired.
lines.zh: : 感觉就在前几天，你还想让我被开除呢。

lines.en: : Now look at us, bonding in your bedroom.
lines.zh: : 现在看看咱俩，在你卧室里培养感情。

lines.en: : Please don’t steer this conversation into a strange direction or I absolutely {i}will{/i} have you fired.
lines.zh: : 请别把话题往奇怪的方向带，不然我绝对{i}会{/i}让你被开除。

lines.en: : You are only here today because I wanted someone to complain to and have an admittedly hard time bonding with those beneath me.
lines.zh: : 你今天能在这儿，只是因为我想找个人发发牢骚，而我承认，跟「不如我」的人实在很难培养感情。

lines.en: : What happened to not placing yourself above others?
lines.zh: : 你之前不是说「不把自己凌驾于别人之上」吗？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm2
: I meant the first floor, which is directly beneath this one.
lines.zh: : 我指的是一楼，就在这间正下方。

lines.en: : Typical Touka, always thinking she’s on a higher level than everyone around her.
lines.zh: : 典型的 Touka，总觉得自己比周围所有人都「高一层」。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm3
: Stop it! I’m referring to the actual vertical distance between the second floor and the first!
lines.zh: : 住口！我说的是二楼和一楼之间真实的垂直距离！

lines.en: : I invited you in to get rid of my bad feelings and you’ve gone and created even more of them! Apologize!
lines.zh: : 我请你进来是想赶跑坏情绪的，你倒好，给我制造了更多！道歉！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Tsukiko.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Tsukiko。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm4
: Why do I bother continuing to let you talk to me when I could have you assassinated in a matter of minutes?
lines.zh: : 我干嘛还要继续跟你说话？我大可以在几分钟内把你做掉。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm5
: Anyway, I’m glad you showed up when you did. I was beginning to feel rather uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 总之，幸好你来了。我刚才已经开始觉得相当不自在了。

lines.en: : Please direct your attention to the left hand side of the room.
lines.zh: : 请把你的注意力转向房间左手边。

lines.en: : Hold on, what was that about having me assassinated?
lines.zh: : 等等，刚才「把我做掉」是什么意思？

lines.en: : That's not a thing you can just ignore.
lines.zh: : 那种话可没法就这么糊弄过去。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you are talking about.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : That’s-
: Wait, what’s happening on the left hand side of the room?
lines.zh: : 等等，房间左手边在干嘛？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm6
: Uhh...
: What is she doing?
lines.zh: : 她在干嘛？

lines.en: : I have no idea. She has been sitting there ever since we got back home and will not speak a word to me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。从我们回到家起她就一直坐在那儿，一句话都不跟我说。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm7
: Am I going to die tonight?
lines.zh: : 我今晚会死吗？

lines.en: : Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。

lines.en: : Have you two been getting along any better?
lines.zh: : 你们俩相处得好点了吗？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm8
: Does it look like we have been getting along any better?
lines.zh: : 看着像我们相处得好点了吗？

lines.en: : It doesn’t look like you {i}haven’t{/i}.
lines.zh: : 看着也不像{i}没{/i}好点。

lines.en: : Is this what you wanted to vent about?
lines.zh: : 你想发牢骚的就是这个？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm9
: I suppose so. Though I will admit that it is infinitely better than hearing her whisper to her dry erase board at 3:00 in the morning.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。不过我得承认，这比凌晨三点听她对着白板自言自语强太多了。

lines.en: : She gave up on turning the lights off too, so that is a plus.
lines.zh: : 她也放弃关灯了，所以这点也算个进步。

lines.en: : Yeah. Huge improvement, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我相信进步巨大。

lines.en: : It will probably be best if we just pretend she is not there and carry on with the conversation topic I chose for us upon your arrival.
lines.zh: : 最好我们就当她不存在，继续聊你来之前我给我们俩定好的话题。

lines.en: : Sure. And that topic is?
lines.zh: : 行。那话题是？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm10
: You, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是你。

lines.en: : Did you really invite me into your room so you could vent about me {i}to{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 你真把我叫进你房间，就为了{i}当着我的面{/i}抱怨我？

lines.en: : Well I can not vent to Yasu while she is pretending to be a chair.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，Yasu 正假装自己是一把椅子，我总不能跟她发牢骚。

lines.en: : Right. And everyone else is below you.
lines.zh: : 对。而其他人都「不如」你。

lines.en: : In terms of physical verticality, yes. They are.
lines.zh: : 就物理上的垂直位置而言，是的。她们确实不如。

lines.en: : And the rest of the girls on this floor?
lines.zh: : 那这层楼的其他女孩呢？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm11
: I attempted to have a conversation with the green-haired girl and it...did not go very well.
lines.zh: : 我试着跟那个绿头发的女孩聊了聊，结果……不太顺利。

lines.en: : So I returned to my room to simply wait for the day to end so I can try again tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 所以我就回了房间，干等着这一天结束，好明天再试一次。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, you picked the one girl on this entire floor that just doesn’t want to talk to anyone.
lines.zh: : 不巧，你偏偏挑了这整层楼里最不想跟任何人说话的那个女孩。

lines.en: : I’m sure it wasn’t personal.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定那不是针对你个人。

lines.en: : Well it certainly {i}felt{/i} personal.
lines.zh: : 可那{i}感觉{/i}就是针对我个人。

lines.en: : I have realized as of late that I am no stranger to accidentally offending people, but I didn’t know that simply saying hello was enough to warrant such unbecoming glares.
lines.zh: : 我最近才意识到，我不是第一次无意中得罪人了，但我不知道光是打个招呼，就足以招来那么失礼的白眼。

lines.en: : Yeah, she does that. Just move on and try someone else.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她就那样。别管了，换个人试试。

lines.en: : Even though they’re both {i}below{/i} you, Ayane and Chika don’t seem to have a problem talking to you.
lines.zh: : 尽管她俩都「{i}不如{/i}」你，Ayane 和 Chika 好像都不排斥跟你说话。

lines.en: : No, they do not. But they are also always doing things and I am never doing anything.
lines.zh: : 对，她们不排斥。可她们也老是在忙这忙那，而我永远无所事事。

lines.en: : Alas, I remain alone in a half filled room talking to my teacher because I am too fearful to show my face in the hall again.
lines.zh: : 唉，我只能独自待在这间半空的房间里，跟我的老师说话——因为我太害怕，不敢再在走廊里露面了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll get over it in a second when you remember you called me in here to complain about me.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，你一想起你是叫我来抱怨我的，立马就不难过了。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm12
: Oh, right! Thank you kindly for reminding me!
lines.zh: : 哦，对！多谢你特意提醒！

lines.en: : You are a bad man!
lines.zh: : 你是个坏男人！

lines.en: : You’re welcome and I know.
lines.zh: : 不客气，而且我知道。

lines.en: : What did I do this time?
lines.zh: : 我这次又干了什么？

lines.en: : Knowingly invited me to live in a room with a crazy person!
lines.zh: : 明知室友是个疯子，还安排我住进这间房！

lines.en: : You’re still going on about that? Whatever happened to bonding over horses and dead people?
lines.zh: : 你还在念叨那个？之前「借马和死人培养感情」那套哪儿去了？

lines.en: : I showed Yasu a picture of my favorite horse when we returned to the dorm that night and she proceeded to maniacally laugh for five whole minutes!
lines.zh: : 那晚回宿舍后，我给 Yasu 看了我最爱的马的照片，结果她狂笑了整整五分钟！

lines.en: : I still do not understand why!
lines.zh: : 我到现在都不明白为什么！

lines.en: : Maybe it was a funny looking horse?
lines.zh: : 也许那是匹长相滑稽的马？

lines.en: : It’s a beautiful black Misaki and cost my family an absolute fortune!
lines.zh: : 那是一匹漂亮的黑色 Misaki，花了我家一大笔钱！

lines.en: if brony == True:
: Damn. That's not even the kind that I'd want to have sex with.
lines.zh: : 靠。那还不是我想跟之上床的那种。

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that means but, I’m sure it was funny looking if it made Yasu laugh for five minutes.
lines.zh: : 我完全听不懂那是什么意思，但我敢肯定，能让 Yasu 笑上五分钟，那马长得肯定很滑稽。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm13
: Sensei...You probably do not understand this as you don’t sleep in the same room as her, but Yasu is very much not a run of the mill commoner.
lines.zh: : Sensei……你不跟她睡同一间房，大概理解不了，但 Yasu 绝不是个普普通通的平民。

lines.en: : You really don’t have to live with her to figure that out.
lines.zh: : 这事你真不用跟她同住也能看出来。

lines.en: : Then why would you subject {i}me{/i}, of all people, to the brutal test of willpower that is befriending her?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么要偏偏让{i}我{/i}经受「跟她交朋友」这种残酷的意志力考验？

lines.en: : If you don’t like it, why not just go stay in the spare house your parents bought you when you transferred[school]s?
lines.zh: : 你要是不喜欢，干嘛不去住你父母在你转学时给你买的那套空房子？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm14
: Because...sleeping in a house alone is scary...
lines.zh: : 因为……一个人睡在一栋空房子里很可怕……

lines.en: : Oh, right. You’ve been coddled forever, so of course you wouldn’t be used to something like that.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你从小被娇惯着，当然不会习惯这种事。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm15
: Can you stop implying that all of these flaws of mine are the result of selfishness or conceit and instead acknowledge that I might just be genuinely confused?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别再把我的这些缺点都归咎于自私或自负，而是承认我可能只是真的「不知所措」？

lines.en: : I am a fish out of water here and expect special treatment {i}not{/i} because I see myself as a superior being, but because I {i}need{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿就像条离了水的鱼。我需要特殊待遇，{i}不是{/i}因为我把自己当成高人一等的存在，而是因为我{i}真的需要{/i}。

lines.en: : So yes, I apologize dearly, but I am very mad at you as the man who is now at least partially responsible for the woman I will ultimately become one day.
lines.zh: : 所以，是的，我郑重道歉，但我对你很生气——因为你这个男人，如今至少要为「我将来会成为怎样的女人」负一部分责任。

lines.en: Unfortunately for Touka, that day will never come.
lines.zh: 可惜对 Touka 来说，那一天永远不会到来。

lines.en: But I suppose that I have been a little harsh to her ever since she arrived when she clearly {i}is{/i} trying.
lines.zh: 不过我想，自打她来了之后，我对她是{i}有{/i}点太苛刻了——她明明是在努力。

lines.en: : Fine, yeah. I get it. You’re abnormal.
lines.zh: : 行，好吧。我懂了。你不正常。

lines.en: : But if you’re going to vent in an “unladylike manner” like you said before, you should avoid saying things like “I apologize dearly” and just really lay into me.
lines.zh: : 不过你要想像你之前说的那样「不淑女」地发火，就别说「我郑重道歉」这种话，而是真的狠狠骂我一顿。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm16
: Lay into you?
lines.zh: : 狠狠骂你？

lines.en: : As in...threaten your job and your well being as I’ve been doing in[school]?
lines.zh: : 你是说……像我在学校里那样，威胁你的工作和安危？

lines.en: : No. Like say actual mean things to me about the kind of person you think I am.
lines.zh: : 不。是就「你觉得我是个什么样的人」，对我说点真正难听的话。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm17
: Wait...you are not some sort of...masochist, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等……你该不会是某种……受虐狂吧？

lines.en: : Do you enjoy when powerful women say mean things to you? My mother has told me about those types of men before.
lines.zh: : 有权势的女人对你说难听话，你很享受？我母亲以前跟我讲过那种男人。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m comfortable-
lines.zh: : 我不太确定我舒不舒服——

lines.en: : First off, I’m not a masochist.
lines.zh: : 首先，我不是受虐狂。

lines.en: : Second, what could have possibly compelled your mother to tell you about things like that?
lines.zh: : 其次，你母亲到底怎么会跟你讲那种事？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm18
: It was part of a twelve hour briefing I was given on things I may encounter in what my father referred to as “the wilderness.”
lines.zh: : 那是一场十二小时的「简报」的一部分——讲的是我在我父亲口中的「荒野」里可能遇到的事。

lines.en: : According to my mother and the presentation the family put together, there are these things called “fetishes” that somehow provide pleasure to...certain types of people.
lines.zh: : 根据我母亲和家族整理的那份「演示」，世上有一种叫「性癖」的东西，不知怎的能给……某些类型的人带来快感。

lines.en: : Could it be that...this whole time...you’ve been provoking me for your own satisfaction?
lines.zh: : 会不会……这半年来……你一直在为了自己的满足而激怒我？

lines.en: : I don’t think so, but...you know, at this point, I wouldn’t be surprised if there was some element of truth to that.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得，不过……你知道，到这地步，就算这里面有点真成分，我也不意外了。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm19
: This causes a great deal of stress for me as I will no longer be able to belittle you without the fear of you becoming...excited.
lines.zh: : 这让我压力很大，因为以后我再贬低你，就得担心你会变得……兴奋。

lines.en: : I find myself belittling you quite often, so please suppress your desires until after we are married.
lines.zh: : 我发现自己贬低你的次数相当多，所以请你把欲望压到我们结婚之后再说。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm20
: N-Not that I would ever consider marrying a masochistic commoner like you!
lines.zh: : 我——我才不会考虑嫁给你这种受虐狂平民呢！

lines.en: : Careful, Touka. Yelling at me like that might have some...adverse effects.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Touka。那么冲我吼，可能会有点……不良反应。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm21
: Oh...right.
: Apologies...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……

lines.en: : Please follow me for the rest of the tour.
lines.zh: : 请跟我来，继续参观。

lines.en: scene black
Touka somehow switches into tour guide mode, probably being desperate for a topic change and realizing that she hasn’t shown me around since I entered.
lines.zh: Touka 不知怎么切换到了导游模式——大概是急着换话题，又想起从我进门起还没带我参观过。

lines.en: Not like there’s much to show me anyway, but-
lines.zh: 不过这房间本来也没多少可看的——

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm22
: Wait, hold on. Why do you have a love hotel bed?
lines.zh: : 等等，慢着。你为什么有一张情趣酒店的床？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm23
: What is a love hotel?! It sounds romantic!
lines.zh: : 什么是情趣酒店？！听着好浪漫！

lines.en: : It’s a hotel made for the express purpose of having sex.
lines.zh: : 是专门为了做爱而开的酒店。

lines.en: : This is the exact type of bed they use.
lines.zh: : 这张床正是他们用的那种。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm24
: You are lying to get a rise out of me again, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你又在骗我、想看我跳脚，对吧？

lines.en: : This is the same type of bed I have been using since I was little.
lines.zh: : 我从小就睡这种床。

lines.en: : My mother would never knowingly allow me to sleep in something that...filthy!
lines.zh: : 我母亲绝不会故意让我睡那么……肮脏的东西！

lines.en: : Knowingly, no. But your mother hasn’t seemed to be the most...worldly person so far either.
lines.zh: : 「故意」是不会。不过你母亲到目前为止，看着也不像个很……见过世面的人。

lines.en: : Nonsense, she is fluent in seven languages. That is plenty worldly.
lines.zh: : 胡说，她精通七国语言。那已经够见过世面了。

lines.en: : This is just one more trick out of the many you’ve had the pleasure of playing on me thus far.
lines.zh: : 这不过是你至今有幸戏弄我的诸多把戏里又添的一个。

lines.en: : Does the bed ever vibrate?
lines.zh: : 这张床会震动吗？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm25
: Yes, but...that just means it is set to...sleep mode.
lines.zh: : 会，不过……那只是它调到了……睡眠模式。

lines.en: : Touka, it’s a bed. It is literally always in sleep mode.
lines.zh: : Touka，这是张床。它永远都在「睡眠模式」。

lines.en: : The vibrating is for sex stuff.
lines.zh: : 震动是用来干那种事的。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm26
: No, it is not! I’m not falling for that! It is a high quality, imported bed with...rapid sleep mode technology!
lines.zh: : 不，才不是！我才不上当！这是一张高品质的进口床，带……「快速睡眠模式」技术！

lines.en: : There’s a rapid sleep mode now?
lines.zh: : 现在连「快速睡眠模式」都有了？

lines.en: : For when sleeping just isn’t fast enough!
lines.zh: : 专为「光是睡觉还不够快」的时刻设计！

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm27
: You wouldn’t know because you can’t afford one.
lines.zh: : 你不懂是因为你买不起。

lines.en: : Sure I can. In fact, for just 3,000 yen, I can rent one downtown and-
lines.zh: : 我买得起。其实，只花 3000 日元，我就能在市中心租一张，而且——

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm28
: Yasu! Are you done being a chair yet?! I am cornered by an intimidating man and require your assistance!
lines.zh: : Yasu！你当完椅子了吗？！我被一个气势汹汹的男人逼到墙角了，需要你帮忙！

lines.en: : How is Yasu going to help? She has the constitution of a decrepit old woman.
lines.zh: : Yasu 能帮什么忙？她体质弱得跟个老太太似的。

lines.en: : Mother?! Yumi?!
lines.zh: : 母亲？！Yumi？！

lines.en: : {i}Yumi?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Yumi？{/i}

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm29
: I ran out of people I rely on and inadvertently began to list people I find intimidating.
lines.zh: : 我能指望的人用完了，一不留神就开始数「我觉得吓人」的人了。

lines.en: : If you hadn’t stopped me, I would have likely called out for your assistance next.
lines.zh: : 你要是没拦着我，我下一个多半就要喊你的名字求救了。

lines.en: : Wait, does that mean you find Yumi more intimidating than me?
lines.zh: : 等等，那是不是说，你觉得 Yumi 比我更吓人？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm30
: Yumi has not sworn to protect me and guide me through life while you have. She is clearly more intimidating to me than you are.
lines.zh: : Yumi 可没发誓要保护我、指引我一生，而你发过。所以对我来说，她显然比你吓人。

lines.en: : If you think {i}she’s{/i} intimidating, you should see her mother.
lines.zh: : 你要觉得{i}她{/i}吓人，那你该见见她妈。

lines.en: : Will she be attending the next parent teacher conference?
lines.zh: : 她会来下次家长会吗？

lines.en: : I don't really do those. And even if I did, no. She would definitely not be there.
lines.zh: : 我不怎么开家长会。就算开，她也不会来。绝对不会。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm31
: If you do not hold parent teacher conferences, how are my mother and I to know if my performance is adequate or not?
lines.zh: : 你要是不开家长会，我母亲和我怎么知道我的「表现」达不达标？

lines.en: : What performance? All you do in class is sit around.
lines.zh: : 什么表现？你在课上就光坐着。

lines.en: : That isn’t true. Your assistant actually just gave me a batch of personalized worksheets meant to help with my studies as your methods have not...clicked for me just yet.
lines.zh: : 才不是。你的助手其实刚给了我一批改过的、为我量身定制的练习题——因为你的教学方法对我还……没奏效。

lines.en: : Makoto did that?
lines.zh: : Makoto 做的？

lines.en: : Yes, Makoto. That was her name.
lines.zh: : 对，Makoto。那是她的名字。

lines.en: : I was under the assumption it was a thing she did for everyone, what with being your assistant and all.
lines.zh: : 我还以为那是她作为你助手、给每个人都做的事呢。

lines.en: : I honestly had no idea.
lines.zh: : 我真的一点都不知道。

lines.en: : Well...regardless, how will you be informing my mother and myself of my progress?
lines.zh: : 好吧……不管怎样，你打算怎么向我和我母亲汇报我的进度？

lines.en: : Do we need to arrange for a personal meeting or something of that nature?
lines.zh: : 我们需要安排个单独会面之类的吗？

lines.en: : How about I just...send you an email with a thumbs up or something?
lines.zh: : 要不我就……给你发封邮件、配个大拇指表情什么的？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm32
: An...email?...
lines.zh: : 一封……邮件？……

lines.en: : That’s hardly sufficient, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 那也太不够格了，Sensei……

lines.en: : Your methods sound less and less rational every time you speak about them.
lines.zh: : 你的方法，每次你一提起，听着就越来越不理性。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you sleep in a love hotel bed, so there’s not a lot about you that screams “rational” either.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这个嘛……你睡的是情趣酒店的床，你身上也没多少东西透着「理性」。

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm28
: FOR THE LAST TIME, IT’S A NORMAL BED! AND IT’S VERY COMFORTABLE!
lines.zh: : 最后说一遍，那是张普通的床！而且非常舒服！

lines.en: : Just don’t let Kirin see it or she might get a little excited.
lines.zh: : 就是别让 Kirin 看见，不然她可能会有点兴奋。

lines.en: : I CAN’T EVEN REMEMBER WHICH GIRL THAT IS! THERE ARE SO MANY OF THEM!
lines.zh: : 我都记不清那是哪个女孩了！人也太多了！

lines.en: : If you want, I can go see if she can come over here to confirm-
lines.zh: : 你要想，我可以去看看她能不能过来确认——

lines.en: else:
: Yeah, it looks it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，看出来了。

lines.en: : OH, WOULD YOU LOOK AT THE TIME? I HAVE A...ZOOM CALL WITH MY CROCHET INSTRUCTOR, SO IT IS TIME FOR YOU TO LEAVE!
lines.zh: : 哦，你看看都几点了？我还有个……跟钩针老师的视频课，所以请你走吧！

lines.en: : Crochet? Can I try, Touka?
lines.zh: : 钩针？我能试试吗，Touka？

lines.en: scene toukafirstdorm33
: Oh, Yasu! How nice of you to finally join the conversation! Did you enjoy being a chair?!
lines.zh: : 哦，Yasu！你终于肯加入对话了，真好！当椅子当得开心吗？！

lines.en: : I felt God’s hands on my shoulders. They were so light and-
lines.zh: : 我感觉到上帝的手搭在我肩上。它们好轻，而且——

lines.en: : Wonderful! Let us crochet together, then!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那我们就一起钩针吧！

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei！

lines.en: scene black
Touka quickly pushes me out of the room...and is surprisingly quite strong.
lines.zh: Touka 飞快地把我推出房间……力气还挺大。

lines.en: Of course, I don’t bother fighting back because A: she is a girl. And B: she is a girl.
lines.zh: 当然，我懒得反抗，因为 A：她是个女孩。B：她是个女孩。

lines.en: So I accept defeat for the time being, having just satiated my lust for awkward rich girl content, and begin my walk home through a suddenly heavy snowfall.
lines.zh: 于是我这回认栽——刚刚饱餐了一顿「别扭富家女」的戏码——开始顶着突然变大的雪往家走。

lines.en: Or, at least I start my walk home.
lines.zh: 或者说，至少我开始往家走。

lines.en: Touka wound up sending a driver to pick me up just two or three blocks along.
lines.zh: 结果才走了两三个街区，Touka 就派了个司机来接我。

lines.en: I have no idea why she did that or how it managed to get here so quickly, but I accept the ride and find myself back at home within a matter of minutes.
lines.zh: 我不知道她为什么这么做，也不知道车怎么来得这么快，但我接受了这程车，几分钟后就回到了家。
